integrity: All-prime phase classification is proved symbolically from a three-term sum/squares collision; exact finite checks are supplementary and do not replace the proof. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Sharp constant and necessity of constant modulus are prior Theorem 1.3 of arXiv:2405.16647; new contribution is the phase/equality classification for prime fields \(p\ge5\) only. No claim for non-prime fields or p=2,3. Independent audit not performed; unindexed prior equivalent work remains possible.
title: Complete sixth-moment extremizers on the prime-field parabola
